steps.title: Post
steps.subject: Image: surplus buffet trays
steps.sentence: A donor posts what is left — dish, servings, last-cooked time — and the safety clock starts automatically.

steps.title: Claim
steps.subject: Image: fresh produce at a market
steps.sentence: An NGO claims a listing only when its pickup ETA lands at least 10 minutes before the safe window ends.

steps.title: Track
steps.subject: Image: volunteer on a scooter
steps.sentence: A volunteer picks up the food; everyone watching can follow every stage on a live tracking page.

steps.title: Serve
steps.subject: Image: serving line at a community kitchen
steps.sentence: The receiving NGO serves the meal on time and marks the delivery — impact counts from that moment.
